AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Employee check-in or check-out attendance record with watermarked selfie thumbnail, GPS coordinates, accuracy, geofence distance, and Google Maps link.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated owner.

latitude.description: GPS latitude coordinate in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: GPS longitude coordinate in decimal degrees.

distanceMeters.description: Computed distance in meters from the configured workplace coordinates.

withinRadius.description: Whether the attendance check was within the configured office radius.

mapsUrl.description: Direct Google Maps link for the recorded GPS coordinates.

capturedTimeText.description: Formatted local date and time stamped onto the selfie watermark.

photoBase64.description: Compressed JPEG Base64 string of the watermarked selfie thumbnail.

syncedToSheets.description: Whether the record was also successfully sent to an optional Google Apps Script webhook.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WorkplaceSettings.title: WorkplaceSettings
WorkplaceSettings.description: Per-user employee defaults, office geofence coordinates, maximum allowed radius, and optional Google Apps Script webhook URL.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated owner.

officeName.description: Display name of the workplace location.

officeLatitude.description: Workplace target latitude in decimal degrees.

officeLongitude.description: Workplace target longitude in decimal degrees.

maxRadiusMeters.description: Maximum allowed geofence radius in meters (default 100).

geofenceEnabled.description: Whether strict office radius validation is enforced before submitting attendance.

sheetsWebhookUrl.description: Optional Google Apps Script Web App URL for forwarding attendance records to Google Sheets and Drive.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-scoped workplace geofence, employee defaults, and Google Sheets webhook settings (document ID: workplace).
